description: Format a Korean legal citation per standard legal conventions. Formats: "korean" -> "제15조 개인정보 보호법", "full" -> "Article 15, Personal Information Protection Act", "short" -> "Art. 15, PIPA", "pinpoint" -> "제15조제1항". Does NOT validate existence -- use validate_citation for that.

citation.description: Citation string to format (e.g., "제15조 개인정보 보호법" or "Article 15, PIPA")

format.description: Output format. "korean" (default): 제N조 format. "full": formal English. "short": abbreviated. "pinpoint": article reference only.

name: format_citation
